text:
alejandro: FYI seeing apiserver 503s in eu-south starting ~12:07 UTC, controller-manager requeue rate jumped. Looks tied to a flurry of GPU node attaches.
mira: on it, checking provisioner logs. any obvious fd leaks on apiserver pods?
sam: I saw apiserver fd_count spike on one replica right before the 503 burst.
alejandro: exact, fd_count ~ 65k on apiserver-1, others around 4-5k. weird aggregation after a burst of webhook requests.
jen: @mira can you share the kube-apiserver logs snippet? maybe webhook timeout or proxy half-open
mira: grabbing logs now, pasting minimal lines:
```
I0312 12:07:22.345678 1 http2_server.go:248] http2: server: error reading preface: net/http: TLS handshake timeout
E0312 12:07:22.345901 1 server.go:512] apiserver error: "rpc error: code = ResourceExhausted desc = file descriptor limit exceeded"
```
sam: that TLS handshake timeout with FD explosion smells like conntrack / NAT port exhaustion downstream too.
kyle: also seeing provisioner spike: 40 GPU attaches in 2m in eu-south, many in Pending state for >30s causing controller churn
alejandro: so two pressure vectors: attach churn from onboarding + apiserver file descriptor blowout causing 503s and controller-manager requeues -> double feedback loop
ops-bot: Incident note created: INC-2468: eu-south apiserver 503s and GPU attach-induced churn
mira: rolling temp mitigation: bump apiserver ulimits on the pod (soft 100k), and add iptables conntrack more aggressive timeouts on NAT routers (wip)
jen: Can we defer low-priority GPU attaches to Dedicated burst queue? If we throttle attaching from scheduler side we can break the feedback loop.
sam: good idea — set provisioner attach throttle to 8/min for eu-south, propagate policy to scheduler plugin via /api/v1/internal/attach-control
kyle: started a canary patch to provisioner: `--attach-rate=8m` now in staging, will push to prod in 2m if metrics look stable
alejandro: also enable apiserver prefix-KV caching to reduce gateway load for webhook lookups — short term patch
mira: after ulimit bump and throttle, fd_count dropped to ~6k and 503s subsided ~2m ago. controller requeue rate halved.
jen: cost note: throttling will increase attach latency for queued jobs; ops, please log cost/latency delta for next billing window.
alejandro: filing follow-up action items: 1) permanent apiserver ulimit and conntrack tuning (mira+sam) 2) provisioner attach backpressure by region (kyle) 3) scheduler priority queueing for GPU onboarding (jen) 4) postmortem w/ cost impact (alejandro)
sam: copying relevant logs to S3: s3://redwood-ops/eus-apiserver/2468001357/logs.tar.gz
mira: I'll update the runbook with the conntrack heuristics and the attach-throttle knob. ping if anything regresses :thumbsup:
alejandro: thanks team. keep this thread for followups, remote postmortem tomorrow 09:30 PT.
